scientific limitations/integrity: Exact unrestricted minimum-area enclosing parallelogram profile for convex centrally symmetric nondegenerate hexagons only. Uses three side-generator determinant magnitudes and an analytic normal-fan extremum lemma; the sharp ratio and affine invariant stability are proved. Does not extend to arbitrary nonsymmetric polygons or higher-dimensional bodies, and does not assert Hausdorff or Banach-Mazur metric stability. The classical four-thirds upper bound and affine-regular equality class are credited to earlier literature, not claimed as novel.
title: Exact enclosing-parallelogram profile and sharp affine stability for symmetric hexagons
